 Oct 10, 2026; Annapolis, Maryland, USA; Tulsa Golden Hurricane quarterback Baylor Hayes (10) looks to throw down field during the second half against the Navy Midshipmen at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Tommy Gilligan-Imagn Images
 How to Watch Army vs Tulsa
 When: Friday, October 23, 2026
 Time: 8:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: ESPN2
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Army enters Friday's matchup riding a two-game winning streak after dominating Florida Atlantic 56-24 on Saturday. Quarterback Cale Hellums led the Black Knights with 195 rushing yards and five touchdowns, while Jake Rendina added a 61-yard touchdown run, and Bryson Luter broke free for a 69-yard score. Army racked up 479 rushing yards and eight touchdowns on the ground, attempting just two passes all game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tulsa looks to build on a 38-17 victory over Rice on Saturday that snapped a three-game losing streak. Quarterback Baylor Hayes completed 20 of 27 passes for 249 yards and three touchdowns without an interception, while Trequan Jones rushed for 77 yards and a score on 12 carries. Oran Singleton Jr. caught seven passes for 87 yards and a touchdown, and linebacker Tyson Williams recorded a career-high 12 tackles. The Golden Hurricane overcame an early 17-7 deficit by scoring 31 unanswered points, holding Rice scoreless in the second half to earn their first American Conference victory of the season.
